title: VOL (Volantio) ? INVOL (SELFREACC) � Promise = Last VOL Before SELFREACC
description:
Customer's flight was voluntarily changed via Volantio (VOL), then AC cancelled and customer self-rebooked via SELFREACC (INVOL). Validates that promise = last VOL arrival (12:00) before the SELFREACC, since SELFREACC = INVOL and does NOT update promise.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Julie Bergeron); 1 leg AC YUL?YYZ; Original (14-day) arrival: 10:00; Change 1 (D-6): Volantio VOL (SK VOLY) ? new arrival 12:00; Change 2 (D-1): INVOL cancellation; Change 3 (D-1): SELFREACC (XXXAC08SR) ? new arrival 16:00; Actual arrival: 16:00; Code: 42 (Controllable); 72 hrs elapsed; No duplicate; Not employee; Not infant
